purpose: Certify a unique reproducible finite-window H3 boundary that preserves zero second-order field coordinates q20=0 at z=1.5 while determining the canonical momenta from the independent lapse and shift constraints.

boundary_definition.momenta: p0=(pS20,pu20,pphi20,pT20) chosen by a frozen equilibrated minimum-norm solve of the independent lapse+shift affine constraints after algebraic reconstruction
boundary_definition.interpretation: constraint-projected zero-coordinate window-local particular boundary; not a primordial second-order initial condition and not a claim that omitted homogeneous history vanishes physically

frozen_solver_rule.system: 2x4 complex affine constraint system in canonical momenta with q=0
frozen_solver_rule.column_scaling: after row scaling divide each momentum column by its max absolute row-scaled coefficient
frozen_solver_rule.base_solve: minimum Euclidean norm in the doubly equilibrated momentum coordinates using scipy.linalg.lstsq with LAPACK driver gelsd
frozen_solver_rule.iterative_refinement: exactly 4 correction sweeps in the same frozen scaled coordinates; each sweep solves the current original-equation residual with the same equilibrated pseudoinverse rule

tests: reproduce the exact frozen Repair13 background and Repair14 quadratic source used by Repair17
set q0=0 for every C,beta0,m=1..40 on Nt=64 and Nt=32
construct the same frozen algebraic reconstruction w= WY y + WR source
solve only for p0 using the frozen doubly equilibrated minimum-norm rule
perform exactly four frozen iterative-refinement sweeps
verify independent lapse and shift backward errors
report p0 norm, scaled solution norm, singular values, effective rank and primary/control reproducibility
compare descriptively against the Repair17 p-only witness without changing any gate

routing.ZERO_COORDINATE_CONSTRAINT_PROJECTED_MOM: all frozen gates pass in every material case
routing.ZERO_COORDINATE_BOUNDARY_NUMERICALLY_UNR: the p-only manifold exists but the frozen solver rule fails one or more numerical gates
